comments.typecheck: `ngc`, not `tsc --noEmit`. tsc compiles the TypeScript but never looks at a template, so every `mm-*` binding would go unchecked and the whole reason design-system-angular exists would be forfeited. There is no `--noEmit` equivalent for ngc, hence the throwaway outDir (gitignored with the rest of dist).
comments.angular-compiler: @angular/compiler and @angular/compiler-cli are devDependencies, not dependencies: this package is AOT-compiled by @ngtools/webpack, so templates are compiled at build time and the compiler never reaches the browser. Listing them as runtime dependencies is what accidentally ships ~200 kB of compiler to every visitor.
comments.babel-loader: The only babel loader in the monorepo, and it is not a transpiler here. Runs exactly one plugin @angular/compiler-cli/linker/babel, which rewrites Angular decorators to be tree-shakable. This is a build-time concern, not a runtime concern, so it is a devDependency.
